terra.problem: Papa refers to his own phone. Phones outside his bakery can only come up as things people use.
Calling the threatened fire a forest getting 'very warm' makes light of its destruction.
The passage does not say the green trees are the last to burn or specify how hot the fire is.
The claim that there is never any guessing when God does something goes beyond what the verse says about this fire.
The passage reports the people's question about parables; it does not say they shrug off the warning as a story.
Saying the people brush Ezekiel off adds a response beyond the question he reports.
The people are to ask why Ezekiel is groaning, not the further question about the news that the explanation implies they are asking.
The joke about dough having more backbone makes light of the people's suffering in the warning.
The clipboard joke makes light of the people and princes being subjected to the sword.
The sword closing in on every side does not explicitly say there is no way out.
Closing in does not establish how close the sword already is, or rule out its coming from far away.
The verse appoints the sword at all their gates; it does not say the people stumble at the gates.
The nap joke makes light of the threat of slaughter.
The directions to the blade do not say that nobody can get around it by choosing a side.
